svg.aria-label: Decision matrix. Short data life cycle pushes toward age out. A downtime window that fits the data volume pushes toward dump and restore. No downtime or a required rollback pushes toward blue/green. Legal retention fits age out, or moving everything. Heavy join and aggregation pain fits any door with the optimization track. Running two systems is needed by age out and blue/green. Budget for replication tools fits blue/green
